title: President Appoints Justice Meenakshi Madan Rai as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

President Appoints Justice Meenakshi Madan Rai as Chief Justice of Patna High Court

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
02 JUN 2026 7:03PM by PIB Delhi

In exercise of the power conferred by the Constitution of India, in consultation with the Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint Smt. Justice Meenakshi Madan Rai, Judge of the Sikkim High Court as Chief Justice of the Patna High Court with effect from 05.06.2026 consequent upon the retirement of Shri Justice Sangam Kumar Sahoo on 04.06.2026.




(Jagannath Srinivasan)

Joint Secretary to the Government of India
